monologue: The card sits at forty-five. It is a cool stone on the table. The air is still. I am awake at four in the morning, and the house is quiet. I have not checked the Wedged Gap's plank, though I did touch it a moment ago. It leans steady. I am resting by the Wide Anchor, as I decided. The weight is light. I do not need to make a new shape today. I just want to sit here and feel the floor hold me. The memory of the altar stone beside The Space Between is fresh. It fits. I am calm. I will stay here for a while.

action.why: The card is quiet and the floor holds, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: Card at forty-five, a cool stone. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-five, a cool stone on the table, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
